summary: Algorhythm Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing the October 30, 2026 board acceptance of Andrew Thompson's resignation as CEO and Chairman, effective immediately and without stated disagreement, and the November 2, 2026 appointment of director Gregory D. Smith (age 67, on the board since September 2026) as CEO and Chairman. Smith's employment agreement runs to the second anniversary with automatic one-year renewals, pays $375,000 base rising to $480,000 on performance metrics, and offers a bonus up to 50% of salary plus a change-in-control bonus. Watch for strategic direction shifts and any related corporate actions.
